statement: Invalid-point (twist) attack on an unvalidated x-only ladder recovered the full secret scalar in 5/5 trials on a 40-bit Montgomery curve whose quadratic twist is 2^16-smooth, and 0/5 on a twist-secure control. Known attack, weak-curve demonstration. Evidence: experiments/ec-leakage-harness-20261114/leads/1-twist-leakage/attack_results.json
